commissionIdentity: one cross-platform phone-and-desktop bootstrap; no ChatGPT browser orchestration; battery governor deferred

mission.outcome: Add one Python bootstrap entrypoint that detects Android/Termux or Windows, installs and repairs the existing Home Center machine bodies, establishes local-inference continuity, configures deterministic startup, and emits durable receipts.
mission.executionLane: repository implementation now; phone and Windows execution only through their native local shells or an existing callable Home Center body
mission.deliverySurface: one repository script plus tests, documentation, and campaign receipts
exclusions: a second swarm daemon or fourth operator surface
automatic credential invention or secret logging
battery/charge-aware workload governing in this slice
claims that either physical device was updated without fresh device receipts

selectedJudgmentJars.reason: Preserve the requested single-script, native-machine, non-browser lane.
Reuse Home Center and Vlad; do not create a duplicate watcher; keep capture and delivery truth separate.
Provide local inference and deterministic operation without cloud-model fallback.
Separate source validation from physical deployment and acceptance.
Wrap existing machine bodies instead of replacing them.
Classify failures, preserve exact errors, and avoid blind retry loops.
Require independent plan and completion review.
Use native startup and bounded repair rather than token-burning observation.

antagonismFindings: A second worker architecture would strand the existing bodies again; the patch must dispatch and repair, not replace.
A repository commit proves source only; phone and Windows deployment require their own receipts.

Screen lock is supportable through native services/tasks. Closed-lid execution is physically impossible while Windows sleeps, so this slice may only preserve AC-side wake policy with an explicit reversible mechanism.
Secrets must enter through environment or explicit prompt and must never appear in command logs or receipts.
First-install package/model downloads may require network, but runtime inference must have no cloud fallback.
Battery workload governing is recorded as deferred work and must not metastasize into this bootstrap patch.
veniceFindings: One Python entrypoint is appropriate because both commissioned machines already have Python; shell-specific actions remain behind bounded adapters.
Android should invoke the existing llama.cpp phone setup, Adam installer, and Vlad daemon setup, then use Termux:Boot and wake lock.
Windows should preserve the existing Computer Hands worker contract, ensure the canonical Ollama models, and use Scheduled Tasks for local repair without browser automation.
The script needs install, repair, status, and doctor paths, atomic receipts, an interprocess lock, dry-run support, and exact failure reporting.
PLAN_ALLOWED only for the bounded repository slice; no device deployment claim is authorized without native receipts.
reviewerMemoryConsulted: existing Vlad receipt and daemon ownership law
prior repeated failure mode: building adjacent surfaces instead of wiring the requested body
